mapper.select: SELECT R.ROUTINE_ID, R.USER_NO, R.ROUTINE_NAME, R.ROUTINE_EXPLAIN, R.ROUTINE_START, R.ROUTINE_END, R.CREATED_AT, R.UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT DECODE(A.ACTIVITY_TYPE, 'CARDIO', '유산소', 'WEIGHT', '근력', 'SPORTS', '스포츠', 'STRETCH', '스트레칭', A.ACTIVITY_TYPE -- 일치하는 값이 없으면 원래 값 반환 ) FROM ROUTINE_ITEM_TBL RI JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL A ON RI.ACTIVITY_ID = A.ACTIVITY_ID WHERE RI.ROUTINE_ID = R.ROUTINE_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS CATEGORY_SUMMARY, ( SELECT LISTAGG( DECODE(RD.DAY_OF_WEEK, 1, '월', 2, '화', 3, '수', 4, '목', 5, '금', 6, '토', 7, '일', RD.DAY_OF_WEEK -- 일치하지 않으면 원래 숫자 반환 (디버깅용) ) , ',') WITHIN GROUP ( ORDER BY RD.DAY_OF_WEEK -- 숫자 코드를 기준으로 정렬 (1=월, 2=화...) ) FROM ROUTINE_ITEM_TBL RI JOIN ROUTINE_ITEM_DAY_TBL RD ON RI.ROUTINE_ITEM_ID = RD.ROUTINE_ITEM_ID WHERE RI.ROUTINE_ID = R.ROUTINE_ID ) AS DAYS_SUMMARY, ( SELECT SUM(A.CAL_PER_MIN * RI.DURATION_MIN) FROM ROUTINE_ITEM_TBL RI JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL A ON RI.ACTIVITY_ID = A.ACTIVITY_ID WHERE RI.ROUTINE_ID = R.ROUTINE_ID ) AS TOTAL_KCAl FROM ROUTINE_TBL R WHERE R.USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT ACTIVITY_NAME FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ACTIVITY_NAME
SELECT CAL_PER_MIN FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME = #{activityName}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_ROUTINE_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ROUTINE_TBL( ROUTINE_ID, USER_NO, ROUTINE_NAME, ROUTINE_EXPLAIN, ROUTINE_START, ROUTINE_END, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES( #{routineId}, #{userNo}, #{routineName}, #{routineExplain, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{routineStart, jdbcType=DATE}, #{routineEnd, jdbcType=DATE}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )

SELECT SEQ_ROUTINE_ITEM_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ROUTINE_ITEM_TBL( ROUTINE_ITEM_ID, ROUTINE_ID, ACTIVITY_ID, TARGET_SET, TARGET_REPS, DURATION_MIN, START_TIME ) VALUES( #{routineItemId}, #{routineId}, #{activityId}, #{targetSet, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{targetReps, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{durationMin, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, TO_DATE(#{startTime}, 'HH24:MI') )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ROUTINE_TBL WHERE ROUTINE_ID = #{routineId} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO GOAL_TBL USING DUAL ON (USER_NO = #{userNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET GOAL_CALORIE_ACTIVITY_WEEKLY = #{goalCalorie}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_NO, GOAL_CALORIE_ACTIVITY_WEEKLY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{goalCalorie}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
